messages:
maya: FYI alert just came in — eu-west1 embeddings latency tail jumped ~8x after the last canary of quant-llm-v2. Customers in EU started seeing timeouts. Need a hotfix window now.
kevin: ouch. any sign it's traffic pattern or model regression?
maya: looks model-related — p99 and p999 for short context requests. No infra OOMs. Grafana link: https://grafana/redwood/eu-embeds (snapshot).
ryan: recommend we pin back to quant-llm-v1 on dedicated eu pool and skip canary for the rollback. This is narrow and time-sensitive.
tara: agree with pin if ops+infra okay.
maya: deploybot — can you show pin command and estimated impact?
deploybot: auto: canary report for quant-llm-v2: failures 0.3%, p999 latency 3.8s -> 28s. Suggested action: pin previous model or rollback canary.
kevin: ops check: if we pin, will we need a data plane restart or just routing switch?
ops-bot: ops-bot: routing switch only for model alias, no pod restarts. Minor connection churn for in-flight KV caches. Expect <1% error blip for <30s.
ryan: ok. approval model: need two ENG approvals + ops signoff to bypass normal canary. I have one (ryan). maya you're owner — second?
maya: I approve. tara?
tara: approved. go ahead. :thumbsup:
kevin: ops signoff granted. long-term root-cause followup required.
maya: executing. command I'll run via deploybot: 
```
/deploybot pin-model --model quant-llm-v1 --alias eu-embed-default --region eu-west1 --force --reason "hotfix: quant-llm-v2 latency regression"
```
ryan: I'll monitor latency + 5xx for 15m and ready to rollback pin.
deploybot: action queued by maya, awaiting approvals: required(eng:2, ops:1) — approvals satisfied. executing...
kevin: tagging release notes stub: "eu embeddings: rolled back to quant-llm-v1 due to latency regression in quant-llm-v2 canary". Link to PR when done.
maya: running now.
deploybot: done: model alias eu-embed-default -> quant-llm-v1 (eu-west1). change-id: ch_3467891230_pin. Duration ~12s.
ryan: seeing p99 back to normal at ~180ms, p999 down to 320ms. No errors spiking.
tara: :thumbsup: nice.
kevin: leaving a note: keep canary paused for quant-llm-v2 until the eval team signs off on perf tests.
maya: will file issue and assign to mlperf / eng-ml for perf regression triage. Release note PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/874 (WIP).
ops-bot: scheduled post-mortem check-in tomorrow 11:00 UTC with infra + ml + ops. calendar invite sent.
ryan: thanks everyone. closing thread once release note PR merged.
maya: thanks — monitoring for 30m, will ping if anything reappears. :eyes:
